purpose: Determine, using a deterministic aggregate sample of the frozen v094c mechanical candidates reconstructed without reading the candidate CSV, whether positive/independent confirmations are usually detections of the same Gaia EDR3 object and whether that same object is present on the control scan but displaced beyond the frozen 5 arcsec control gate, absent despite predicted detectability, or unresolved. This is a mechanism audit only, before corrected population construction, candidate inspection, or registration.

interpretation_at_freeze: Local random-coincidence density is insufficient to explain the 251-300 confirmation excess.
Simple global control-catalogue sparsity or faint-limit deficit is not supported as the main explanation.
Wholesale scan/process duplication is not supported as the main explanation.
The next discriminant is source-level identity and control recovery, assessed only in aggregate.

deterministic_sampling.sampling_unit: mechanically confirmed v094c candidate row reconstructed from frozen source caches; candidate CSV is not read
deterministic_sampling.hash_key: SHA256(triplet_index|positive representative source IDs|independent representative source IDs)
deterministic_sampling.selection: lowest unsigned 64-bit hash values within each predeclared stratum

applause_dr4.source_calib_science_sample.selection: source_id values derived solely from the deterministic frozen sample

applause_dr4.source_calib_control_recove.selection: only control scan IDs from sampled triplets and Gaia IDs resolved prospectively from same-Gaia positive/independent science pairs
applause_dr4.source_calib_control_recove.purpose: test whether the same Gaia object exists anywhere in the valid control source catalogue and measure its extracted-position displacement

applause_dr4.plate.selection: plate IDs appearing in sampled triplets

source_identity_rules.representative_gaia_consensus: non-null Gaia IDs among the one or two underlying scan detections for a plate representative must contain exactly one unique value; record complete versus partial coverage separately
source_identity_rules.science_same_gaia: positive and independent representative Gaia consensus IDs are both resolved and equal
source_identity_rules.science_different_gaia: positive and independent representative Gaia consensus IDs are both resolved and unequal
source_identity_rules.gaia_unresolved: one or both roles have no Gaia ID or conflicting Gaia IDs among multiscan detections

control_recovery_rules.recovered: the same Gaia EDR3 ID appears in at least one valid control scan in applause_dr4.source_calib
control_recovery_rules.recovery_separation: minimum angular separation between the positive representative position and any recovered same-Gaia control source position
control_recovery_rules.consistency_rule: a recovered same-Gaia control source at <=5 arcsec contradicts the frozen v094c control-mismatch replay and is an explicit provenance/mechanical HOLD, not silently accepted
control_recovery_rules.no_recovery_detectability_proxy: estimate Gaia-derived natural magnitude in the control color term from science cat_natmag, science color_term, Gaia BP-RP, and the frozen v094f control median color_term; compare to the frozen v094f control median faint_limit

compare: whether control emulsion differs when science emulsions agree
whether control filter differs when science filters agree

working_data_boundary: Machine-only work caches may contain sampled source IDs, Gaia IDs, and calibrated positions because they are necessary for reproducible aggregate source-identity testing. They are not candidate adjudication products, are not printed to the console, and must not be copied into result outputs. Raw TAP responses are retained under work/ for provenance.
interpretive_boundary: v094g may identify aggregate evidence that v094c rows are dominated by persistent Gaia-associated sources, control astrometric displacement, source-specific control non-recovery, crowding, artifacts, or plate-response differences. It does not establish any individual source as transient or non-transient, does not adjudicate a candidate, and does not define or execute a corrected Branch A/B/C population.
next_stop: Interpret v094g Gaia/control-recovery mechanism evidence before corrected-population design, candidate inspection, or registration.
